mapper.select: SELECT outbound_id FROM wms_sales_pick_work WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId}
SELECT sales_order_id FROM wms_sales_pick_work WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND outbound_id = #{outboundId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_sales_pick_work(tenant_id, outbound_id, sales_order_id, operator_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{outboundId}, #{salesOrderId}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT b.batch_no, o.order_id, o.reference_id, b.warehouse_id, b.seller_sku, l.supplier_batch_no, o.created_at, b.location_id, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode) AS location_code, 'AVAILABLE' AS status, b.quantity - b.reserved_quantity AS quantity FROM wms_batch_location_balance b JOIN wms_warehouse_location p ON p.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND p.location_id = b.location_id JOIN wms_inbound_order_line l ON l.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND l.batch_no = b.batch_no JOIN wms_inbound_order o ON o.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN wms_purchase_inspection i ON i.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND i.batch_no = b.batch_no WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND b.seller_sku = #{sellerSku} AND p.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id AND p.enabled AND p.purpose = 'GOOD' AND o.reference_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND i.disposed_at IS NOT NULL AND b.quantity > b.reserved_quantity ORDER BY o.created_at, b.batch_no, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode), b.location_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_outbound_allocation(tenant_id, allocation_id, outbound_id, line_id, sales_line_id, seller_sku, location_id, batch_no, planned_quantity) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{a.allocationId}, #{a.outboundId}, #{a.lineId}, #{a.salesLineId}, #{a.sellerSku}, #{a.locationId}, #{a.batchNo}, #{a.plannedQuantity})
mapper.sql: FROM wms_outbound_allocation a JOIN wms_warehouse_location p ON p.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND p.location_id = a.location_id JOIN wms_inbound_order_line l ON l.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND l.batch_no = a.batch_no JOIN wms_inbound_order o ON o.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND o.order_id = l.order_id
mapper.select:
SELECT a.allocation_id, a.outbound_id, a.line_id, a.sales_line_id, a.seller_sku, a.location_id, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode) AS location_code, a.batch_no, o.order_id, o.reference_id, a.planned_quantity, a.picked_quantity
WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY a.sales_line_id, o.created_at, a.batch_no, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode), a.allocation_id
mapper.sql:
SELECT k.request_id, k.outbound_id, k.allocation_id, a.location_id, COALESCE(p.location_code, p.barcode) AS location_code, a.batch_no, a.seller_sku, o.order_id, o.reference_id, k.quantity, k.operator_id, k.created_at
JOIN wms_actual_pick k ON k.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND k.allocation_id = a.allocation_id
mapper.select: WHERE k.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND k.outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY k.created_at, k.request_id
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_outbound_allocation SET picked_quantity = picked_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND allocation_id = #{allocationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_actual_pick(tenant_id, request_id, outbound_id, allocation_id, quantity, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{p.requestId}, #{p.outboundId}, #{p.allocationId}, #{p.quantity}, #{p.operatorId}, #{p.createdAt})
